title: Egg Hatcher
description: Automatically hatches dropped eggs into their chicken variants before they disappear.
body:
## Egg Hatcher

### What it does
This data pack automatically hatches dropped eggs right before they disappear (after about 5 minutes). For an egg to hatch, it just needs to be sitting on a cozy block like Hay, Mud, or Mud Bricks. When it hatches, a baby chicken pops out, playing a crack sound with some particles.

### Performance
The pack checks how many chickens are nearby. If there are already too many in the area, the egg simply despawns instead of hatching.

### Customization
You can easily tweak settings using `/function egg_hatcher:_config` to change:
- **Density Limit:** How many chickens are allowed in one area.
- **Density Range:** How far away it checks for other chickens.
- **Chance:** The percentage chance an egg will actually hatch.

Edit the `#egg_hatcher:hatcher_blocks` **block tag** to change the valid blocks where an egg must be on top of to hatch.

If you ever need to remove the datapack, use `/function egg_hatcher:uninstall` to get rid of all scoreboards and data.
